UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

activate

Attaches the shared lifecycle every accelerated path uses once its renderer is live: resize listener, host ResizeObserver, the skeleton-layer class, first measure+paint, pool registration, and the idle-deferred loop start.

  • @param host The layer whose canvas just gained a working backend.
  • @param canvas The live overlay canvas — every callsite guarantees it exists.

init2d

Fallback bootstrap — the shared WebGL renderer blitting into the host's 2D canvas. Runs when WebGPU or the wasm artifact is absent; a failed acquire falls through to the pure-CSS shimmer (the canvas is simply dropped).

  • @param host The layer to bring up on the 2D path.
  • @param canvas The layer's overlay canvas — every callsite guarantees it exists.

init

Boot: builds the overlay canvas, prefers the wasm artifact (the FIRST-loading crate — this is the loading placeholder itself), falls back to the shared 2D renderer, then the CSS shimmer.
